title: Refactored Playwright and added more tests
summary:
## Summary
Refactored Playwright test suite to implement comprehensive Page Object Model pattern with improved test organization and reusability.

## Changes
- ✨ Created dedicated page objects for all major pages (Agents, Gateways, MCP Registry, Servers, Tools, Resources, Prompts, Tokens, Team, Version, Metrics)
- 🏗️ Implemented reusable component pattern (Sidebar component)
- 📝 Added comprehensive test coverage for new pages
- 🔧 Improved base page with common utilities
- 📚 Added documentation and migration guides
- 🧪 Enhanced entity-level tests for better isolation

## Files Changed
- 38 files changed, 11,614 insertions(+), 709 deletions(-)
- New page objects in `pages/` directory
- New component pattern in `pages/components/`
- Enhanced entity tests in `entities/`


## Testing
All tests have been validated and follow the Page Object Model pattern for better maintainability.

Signed-off-by: Matei Adrian
